claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Rifaximin is a non-absorbable, gut-restricted rifamycin antibiotic that is not expected to kill cancer cells at 2.5 uM in a pooled 5-day viability screen; any apparent effect would reflect weak, non-selective antibacterial/physicochemical activity rather than a genuine anticancer mechanism.
